cpsc_recalls.name: CPSC recalls
cpsc_recalls.note: Official CPSC JSON REST API. Request five-year RecallDateStart/RecallDateEnd windows so the complete public history is retrievable without one timeout-prone all-history response. CPSC's eFiling library is used for the three document sources.

fsis_recalls.name: FSIS recalls
fsis_recalls.access_note: FSIS documents this public GET JSON API and RSS recalls feed. This host currently responds HTTP 403 to the documented API; do not spoof a browser or bypass the block. Owner fallback: open https://www.fsis.usda.gov/news-events/news-feeds-subscriptions in a normal browser, follow its Recalls RSS link or download the official recall notice, and attach the saved official file to the local recall review.

osha_ita.name: OSHA ITA establishment summaries
osha_ita.access_note: Official OSHA page/download host returned HTTP 403 to this client. No alternate host or browser impersonation is used. Owner fallback: open https://www.osha.gov/itadata in a normal browser, download the current ITA Summary Data CSV, and attach the saved official file to the local OSHA review.

dla_dibbs.name: DLA DIBBS public solicitations
dla_dibbs.access_note: Automated request returns the official DoD Notice and Consent page. No acknowledgement, cookie, scripted browser, or bypass is attempted. Owner step: review/accept DIBBS terms in a normal browser, search the public RFQ listings, download the selected solicitation file, and import it locally. DLA describes DIBBS as its public RFQ search/view system; solicitation downloads are per record, not a documented bulk feed.

cook_county_assessor.name: Cook County Assessor parcel roll
cook_county_assessor.note: Use Socrata SoQL against only the latest tax year and class 211 (Cook County's class 2-11: apartment buildings with 2 to 6 units), with the six needed data fields plus Socrata's update timestamp. This is a narrow initial cohort, not the complete county assessment roll. Configure target_township_codes and target_classes for the venture's chosen appeal area. Initial matching rows are staged in resumable pages; subsequent syncs use the update watermark. Current-year filtered totals and normalized row counts keep the 1% check.
